facts.text: The project titles itself the Unitree B1 Simulation Environment, a simulation environment for the Unitree B1 robot
B1Sim subclasses gymnasium.Env and imports Env and spaces from gymnasium
The constructor opens an in-process PyBullet client: GUI when render_mode is 'human' and DIRECT otherwise
PyBullet gravity is (0, 0, -9.81) and the PyBullet time step is 1/240 s
The bundled b1_raw.urdf is loaded at base position [0.0, 0.0, 1.0], with useFixedBase passed through
A pinocchio RobotWrapper is built from the same URDF
The spaces are built from every non-fixed joint: observation q bounds from jointLowerLimit and jointUpperLimit, the velocity bound from jointMaxVelocity, and the action bounds from +-jointMaxForce
The observation Box is the joint positions followed by the joint velocities and the action Box is the joint torques, all as float32 arrays
reset sets 12 target joint angles to 0.0 and resets each active joint to angle 0.0 with velocity 0.0
reset returns only the q/dq info dict, not a gymnasium (observation, info) pair
step applies the torque command, advances PyBullet by one step and returns only the q/dq info dict, not a gymnasium five-tuple
get_state reads 12 joint positions and velocities with p.getJointState over the active joint ids
send_joint_command applies the commanded torques with p.TORQUE_CONTROL and zero position and velocity gains
The hip joint limit is effort 91.0035, lower -0.75, upper 0.75 and velocity 19.69; the same limit is declared for the other three hips
The thigh joint limit is effort 93.33, lower -1.0, upper 3.5 and velocity 23.32; the same limit is declared for the other three thighs
The knee joint limit is effort 140, lower -2.6, upper -0.6 and velocity 15.55; the same limit is declared for the other three knees
setup.cfg declares numpy>=1.22.3, scipy==1.8.0, pybullet==3.2.5 and gymnasium==0.26.3 as install_requires; pinocchio and bullet_utils are installed separately per the README
The README requires pinocchio and bullet_utils to be installed before the package itself

determinism.notes: the upstream reset accepts seed and options but draws nothing from them: it zeroes the 12 actuated joints and leaves the floating base and the PyBullet world in place, so a reset does not restore a known initial state. The dynamics are deterministic given the same state and torques, but no seed-controlled or reset-based replay is claimed; the fake follows the same zeroing

gaps: the tested fake backend is a per-joint kinematic stand-in: no contacts, floating-base dynamics, inertia coupling, gravity, friction, actuator or sensor model, and no mesh or plane scene; it was never compared with the upstream PyBullet environment, which was not run
the upstream reset zeroes only the 12 actuated joints (b1_env.py:113-116) and does not restore the PyBullet world or the floating base, so reset is partial; the fake mirrors that zeroing

the upstream reset and step return only {'q', 'dq'} (b1_env.py:118-121 and :132-138); the fake converts q and dq into the 24-element observation and returns reward 0 with terminated and truncated false so the Gymnasium bridge can serve the environment

the upstream reset sets every active joint to 0.0 (b1_env.py:113-116) while the four knees have the URDF upper limit -0.6 (b1_raw.urdf:176), so the reset observation lies outside the observation Box for those joints; the bridge carries the observation as returned and does not reject it
the package is checked on the fake backend only: the upstream needs pybullet, gymnasium, numpy, pinocchio and bullet_utils (setup.cfg:18-22, README.md:12-24) and no upstream run was made
no wall-clock pacing (realtime_factor 0); only cap.world.step.v1 advances simulated time, one 1/240 s PyBullet step per tick
rendering (render_mode 'human', b1_env.py:31-34) is not exposed by the cap.world.* classes
snapshot and restore are not offered: B1Sim exposes get_state but no set_state

measures.description: Last observation (derived from the observation space)
measures.name: observation

safe_state.description: the simulation stops advancing: the runtime latches the e-stop, no further step or reset is accepted until mhs.safety.reset clears the latch, and the last joint state stays readable
